content: <thought>Constructed a five‑step retrosynthetic route for the target molecule. The steps (from target back to simple precursors) are: 1) TBS deprotection (template 29646) to give the TBS‑protected intermediate; 2) ester hydrolysis (template 362434) to convert the free carboxylic acid into a methyl ester; 3) Still‑Gennari Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons olefination (template 362435) that disconnects the α,β‑unsaturated ester into an aldehyde fragment and a phosphonate reagent; 4) DIBAL‑H reduction precursor (template 696237) representing the ester that would be reduced to the aldehyde; 5) introduction of the TBS protecting group (template 723262) on the primary alcohol. The JSON tree follows the required schema, with each reaction node containing its template_id and precursor molecules (SMILES).
